{{Top|leg}}
'''Valken Gresh''' was an individual who made a living as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. On one occasion, Gresh ventured into the [[Fioer desert]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaraksander]] in order to capture the [[Supreme Leader/Legends|Supreme Leader]] of the [[Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangites]]. Gresh barely made it away alive and swore never to go up against the NFP again. However, the following day the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] was paid 30,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] by an associate of the corporate executive [[Darred Eloinie]] to rescue Eloinie's daughter [[Cyrstas Eloinie|Cyrstas]], who had been captured by the NFP, and Gresh headed out into the desert to confront the Fundamentalists once again. At some point afterward, Gresh wrote about the incident in the autobiography ''[[Great Hunts I've Lived To Tell About]]''.
